paite: Huan ni nih nung a Paikan Ankuangluina leh Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina om ding ahi a; siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n, amah khem a, man a, ahihlup theihna ding dan azongzong uhi.
heading: Jesu Thah Sawmna / (Mat 26.1-5; Luk 22.1-2; Joh 11.45-53)
english: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

paite: Himahleh, "Ankuanglui sung in hi kei hen, huchi lou in zaw vantang lak ah buaina ahong om kha ding," achi uhi.
english: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

paite: Huan Bethani a phak Simon inn a a-om lai a, ankuang a-um lai in numei khat, alabaster bawm a spiknardi thau gimlim man tampi tawi in ahong a, abawm ahihkham a, alu ah asungta hi.
heading: Bethani Khua A Jesu Thaunilhna / (Mat 26.6-13; Joh 12.1-8)
english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

paite: Himahleh khenkhatte alunghita kei ua, "Bangziak a thau gimlim hihmang mawkmawk ahia?
english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

paite: Hiai thau makhai zathum sang a tamzaw a zuak a, migentheite kiang a piak theih ahi ngal a," achi uhi. Huchi in atung ah aphun uhi.
english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

paite: Jesu'n, "Hih hen aw; bangziak a va hihbuai na hi ua? Ka tung ah thil hoihtak a hih ahi.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

paite: Migentheite na kiang ua om gige ahi ua, na ut hun peuh un na hehpih thei uhi; kei bel na kiang ua om gige lou ding ka hi.
english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

paite: Ahihtheih khamkham a hih ahi; ka pumpi vui ding a sathau nuhkhol ahi.
english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

paite: Huchi in chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, khovel tengteng a tanchinhoih akigenna koipeuh ah hiai numei thilhih, amah theihgigena ding in akigen zel ding,” achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

paite: Huan Judas Iskariot, sawm-le-nihte lak a khat in, Jesu akiang ua zuausan a amatsak theihna ding in siampu liante kiang ah ava hoh hi.
heading: Judas Muanhuai Louhna / (Mat 26.14-16; Luk 22.3-6)
english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

paite: Amau huai thu azaktak un akipak mahmah ua, akiang ah dangka piak achiamta uhi. Huchi in zuausan a matsakdan ding lemtang azongta uhi.
english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

paite: Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh ani masapen a, Paikan Ankuangluina belamnou agoh zelna ni uah, anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Paikan Ankuanglui na nektheihna ding in koi ah va bawl le ung na ut a?" achi uhi.
heading: Paikan Ankuang Nanung Umna / (Mat 26.17-25; Luk 22.7-14; 22.21-23; Joh 13.21-30)
english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

paite: Huchi in anungzuite lak a mi nih asawl a, akiang uah, "Khopi ah va lut unla, huai ah bel a tui pua pasal in ahon tuak dia; amah zui un.
english: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

paite: Huan alutna peuh ah huai inn kempa kiang ah, 'Sinsakpa'n ka nungzuite toh Paikan Ankuang ka nekna ding uh, mikhual inn pindan koi lai ahia? achi,' na chi ding uhi.
english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

paite: Huchi in ama'n inn pindan tungnung zatak, van omsa, mansa dimdiam ahon ensak dia; huai ah ei a ding in bawl un," achi hi.
english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

paite: Huan nungzuite apawt ua, khopi ah ava lut ua, akiang ua agen bangtak in ava mu ua; Paikan Ankuang abawlta uhi.
english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hih in, amah sawm-le-nihte toh ava hohta uhi.
english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

paite: Huan an a-um ua anek lai un Jesu'n, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat, ka kiang a ne sam in, hon zuausan in hon mansak ding," achi hi.
english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

paite: Huan alungkham panta ua, khatkhat in akiang ah, "Keimah ka hi hia?" achi chiat uhi.
english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, ka kuang a tanghou hon diahpihpa ahi.
english: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

paite: Mihing Tapa atanchin agelh bangtak un apai ding; himahleh Mihing Tapa mansak ding mipa tung agik hi! Huai mihing zaw piang keileh amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding," achi hi.
english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

paite: Huan an anek lai un Jesu'n tanghou ala a, avualzawl zoh in abalkham a, akiang uah apia a, "La unla ne un, hiai ka pumpi ahi," achi hi.
heading: Toupa Ankuang Siangthou / (Mat 26.26-30; Luk 22.14-20; 1 Kor 11.23-25)
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

paite: Huan nou ala a, kipahthu agen zoh in akiang uah apia a; huchi in avek un adawn chiat uhi.
english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai ka sisan a thukhun thak ahi, mi tampi a dia pawt ding ahi.
english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Pathian lalgam a athak ka dawn ni atun masiah grep guigah tui ka dawn nawnta kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan la asak zoh un, apawt ua, Olive tang ah apaita uhi.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na vek un lungkia in na hon taisan ding uh. 'Belamchingpa ka khen dia, belamte adalh ding uh' chih gelh ahi ngal a.
heading: Nungzuite Taihsan Ding Thu Jesu'n Agenkhol / (Mat 26.31-35; Luk 22.31-34; Joh 13.36-38)
english: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

paite: Himahleh ka thohnawn nung in Galili gam ah na ma uah ka pai ding," achi hi.
english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Avek un lungkia in hon taisan mah le uh, ke'n zaw ka hon taisan kei ding," achi hi.
english: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, tuzan ngeingei in, ak nihvei akhuan ma in, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

paite: Ama'n bel khauhtak in, "Na sihna ah si sam ding himah leng ka hon kitheihmohbawl kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchibang in achi chiat uhi.
english: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

paite: Huan Gethsemani achih mun uh atung ua; ama'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Ka thum sung teng hiai ah na tu un," achi hi.
heading: Gethsemani Huan A Jesu Thumna / (Mat 26.36-46; Luk 22.39-46)
english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

paite: Peter, Jakob leh Johan api a, nakpitak a lungkham in amangbang mahmah hi.
english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

paite: Huchi in akiang uah, "Ka kha alungkham mahmah a, sihna khop hial ahi; hiai ah om unla, kiging gige un," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

paite: Huan neukha in malam ah ava pai zek a, lei ah abokkhup a, ahihtheihleh huai hun in amah pel ding in athum hi.
english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

paite: "Abba, Pa, bangkim na hihthei a; kei a kipan in hiai nou lamang in; himahleh kei thu hilou in nangmah thuthu hi zaw hen," achi hi.
english: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

paite: Huan ahong pai a, amau ihmu in ahong mu a, huchi in Peter kiang ah, "Simon, ihmu na hi maw? Dakkal khat lel leng kiging gige in na om thei kei maw?
english: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

paite: Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un kiging gige in thum un. Kha in tuh angap a, sa zaw ahat kei,” achi hi.
english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

paite: Huan ava hoh nawn a, athugen ngei gen in athum nawn hi.
english: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

paite: Huan ahong pai nawn a amau ihmu in ahong mu nawn hi, a-ihmut uh asuak mahmah ngal a; athugen dawndan ding leng athei kei uhi.
english: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

paite: Huan ahong pai thumveina ah akiang uah, "Na ihmu lailai uh maw, na tawlnga lailai uh maw? Ahunta ve; ahun hong tungta; Mihing Tapa mikhialte khut a zuausan a piak ahita hi.
english: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

paite: Thou un, i pai ding uh; en un, zuausanpa ahong naita," achi hi.
english: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

paite: Huan agen laitak in, Judas, sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, ahong tung pah a, siampu liante leh laigelhmite leh upate a kipan mipi, namsau leh khetbuk tawite toh.
heading: Jesu Matna / (Mat 26.47-56; Luk 22.47-53; Joh 18.3-12)
english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

paite: Huan zuausanpa'n, "ka tawp peuhmah amah ahi ding; man unla, kizentak in na pimang ding uh," chi in chiamtehna ana hilhkhol dimdiam hi.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

paite: Huchi in atuntak in ava naih a, "Rabbi!" chi in atawp tonton hi.
english: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

paite: Huan amah alen ua, amanta uhi.
english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

paite: Huan akiang a dinghte lak a mi kuahiam in anamsau adok a, siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil asatkhiaksak hi.
english: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

paite: Huan Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Temsaute, khetbukte tawi in suamhat man ding bang in, kei hon man ding in na hong kuan uh maw?
english: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

paite: Tempul ah niteng a thu hilh in na kiang uah ka om a; na hon man ngal kei ua, himahleh Laisiangthou thugelh atuntheihna ding ei ve," achi hi.
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

paite: Huan avek un amah anusia ua, ataimang vekta uhi.
english: They all left him, and fled.

paite: Tangval kuahiam, puanmalngat kia bat in, amah azui a; amah ana man uhi.
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

paite: Himahleh apuanmalngat ataisan a, vuaktang in ataimangta hi.
english: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

paite: Siampu lian kiang ah Jesu api ua; siampu liante, upate leh laigelhmite tengteng toh ahong ton uhi.
heading: Siampu Lian Ma A Jesu Dinna / (Mat 26.57-68; Luk 22.54-55,63-71; Joh 18.13-14,19-24)
english: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

paite: Peter in gamlapi a pai in amah azui a, siampu lianpen inn huangsung kong lai pha in; sikhate lak ah meilum awi in atu sam hi.
english: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

paite: Jesu ahihlup theihna ding un siampu liante leh vaihawmte tengteng in amah hekna azong ua, amu kei uh.
english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

paite: Mi tampi in zuau in ahek ua, himahleh, ahekna thu uh akituak kei hi.
english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

paite: Huan kuate hiam adingh ua, zuau in ahek uhi.
english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

paite: Hiai mi'n, "Khut a lam tempul ka hihse dia, ni thum sung in tempul dang, khut a lam louh, ka lam ding, achih, ka za uh," achi uhi.
english: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

paite: Huchi in leng ahekna thu uh akituak thei sam kei uhi.
english: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

paite: Siampu lianpen alai ah adingkhia a, Jesu kiang ah, "Bangmah a dawng lou maw? Hiaite hon hekna bangchidan ahia?" chi in adong hi.
english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

paite: Amah lah adai dide a, bangmah in adawng kei. Siampu lianpen in akiang ah, "Khrist, Hampha Tapa, na hi hia?" chi in adong nawn hi.
english: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Hi e, Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna taklam a tu a, van meipi lak a hong pai na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

paite: Siampu lianpen in apuansilh abotkek a, "Theihpih dang bang ding in i deih lai dia?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

paite: Pathian agensiatdan na zata uh; bangchi na sa ua?" achi hi. Avek un amah si tak in asep chiat uhi.
english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

paite: Huan akhen in amah achilsiat pah ua, amai tuam in khuttum in atum ua, akiang ah, "Zawlnei bang in gen in," achi uhi; sikhate'n apaipih kawm un akhutpek un abeng ekek uhi.
english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

paite: Huan Peter nuailam a inn huangsung kong lai a a-om lai in siampu lianpen sikha nungakte lak a khat ahong pai a,
heading: Peter In Jesu Kitheihmohbawl / (Mat 26.69-75; Luk 22.54-55,63-71; Joh 18.15-18,25-27)
english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

paite: Peter, meilum awi amu a, a-en a, "Nang leng Nazaret mi Jesu kiang a om na hi ve," achi hi.
english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

paite: Ama'n, "Na thugen ka thei kei, angaihna leng ka thei kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi. Inn lim ah apawtkhia a; huchi in ak akhuangta hi.
english: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

paite: Huan nungak in amu a, akiang a dinghte kiang ah, "Hiai mi alak ua mi ahi," achi nawn hi.
english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

paite: Himahleh akitheihmohbawl nawn hi. Sawt lou nung in akiang a dinghte'n, Peter kiang ah, "Alak ua mi hi tawk teh, Galili gam a mi na hi ngal a,” achi uhi.
english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

paite: Ama'n, "Huai na mihing gen uh ka thei kei," chi in hamsia kiloh in akichiamta hi.
english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

paite: Huan ak khuan nihveina akhuang pah hi. Peter in, Jesu'n akiang a, "Ak nihvei akhuan ma in nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," achih atheikhe thak nawn a, huai angaihtuah a akapta hi.
english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
